closing.summary: Big strengths are omega 3, protein, and practical everyday fruit, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low vitamin A, and low protein quality. It is good for practical meals, energy, and immune support because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, the carb section gives it a clear fuel role, and vitamin C gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
